messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — trigger PD-2026-0891 for service: inference-prod-night (P1) — high 5xx spike on /v1/generate. Auto-page to rota: infra-night-rotation. incident link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-2026-0891
pagerduty: ALERT: PD-2026-0891 — 1200% increase in 5xx over baseline, last spike 30s ago. Acknowledgement window 2m.
alex.k: seeing the PD page — getting page text now. hm the service targeted looks wrong, rota points at infra-night-rotation but that rotation should be for infra-staging.
maria_g: @alex.k I can look, pinging oncall. oncall-night are you getting this?
oncall-night: I got the page. I acked it because my PD is tied to infra-night-rotation. I don't have access to the model infra playbook though.
samir: quick note — we recently added alias "inference-night" that maps to two services for shadowing. pd rule might be matching alias instead of canonical service. can someone check PD rule tags?
dylan: @samir runbook says check the PD service binding: pd-service: inference-prod-main, binding: infra-night-rotation, tag: alias:inference-night. that looks like a misbind.
alex.k: can we mute the PD rule while we triage? don't want escalation to go to oncall-night if they're not responsible.
pagerduty: Suggestion from PD: Add temporary maintenance window OR disable the escalation: use `pdcli maintenance add --service inference-prod-night --duration 30m`
maria_g: I'm not comfortable disabling the service completely. alternative: update routing override to target inference-platform-oncall.
oncall-night: I don't want to be the long-term responder for this. happy to hold while we reroute.
samir: quick mitigation plan: 1) create 15m maintenance on inference-prod-night, 2) create temporary alert-forward to inference-platform-oncall, 3) revert PD binding later.
pm-ryan: customer impact? do we have customers experiencing errors or is this internal noise?
dylan: metric shard shows ~0.8% of requests are 5xx for last 10m, mostly timeouts to kv-cache in region us-west-2. customer-facing page rate minimal but visible. recommend treating as degraded.
alex.k: ok let's do the short maintenance window + forward. I'll run commands.
alex.k: ```
# add 20m maintenance
pdcli maintenance add --service inference-prod-night --duration 20m --description "temp mute while we reroute to platform oncall"
# create extension rule
pdcli extension create --service inference-prod-night --type forward --target inference-platform-oncall
```
maria_g: thanks. I'll update the oncall rotation docs after this. @samir can you roll a quick patch to the PD binding mapping in infra-ops repo? just a one-liner revert would fix alias matching.
samir: copying commands to PR now. I'll add tests for alias->canonical resolution.
oncall-night: acked, will handoff if you need me to stay. I put a :white_check_mark: reaction on the maintenance.
incident-bot: Maintenance created: MNT-5621 (20m) on inference-prod-night. Forwarding extension active to inference-platform-oncall.
pagerduty: Escalations paused while maintenance active. Forwarded alerts will go to inference-platform-oncall.
dylan: platform-oncall acknowledged forwarded alerts and is triaging logs. looks like a transient spike from a bad cache pop — connection resets.
alex.k: platform-oncall says they can remediate cache pool; I'm asking them to scale the pool and roll a restart on kv-proxy.
pm-ryan: please keep customer comms in #support if we see user-facing errors.
incident-bot: PD-2026-0891 status: acknowledged -> under-mitigation. assigned to inference-platform-oncall.
pm-ryan: can we tag this as routing-misbind + followup with postmortem? need root cause and action items: PD binding tests + change-control on alias mappings.
samir: will open a postmortem ticket and assign owners for PD binding fix, test coverage, and runbook update.
alex.k: rolling restart started on kv-proxy in us-west-2. logs show fewer resets. preparing to reduce maintenance in 5m.
incident-bot: Maintenance MNT-5621 ended early (10m). PD-2026-0891 remains closed as metric has returned to baseline.
oncall-night: thanks — I removed myself from further escalation. please follow up with a retro. :thumbsup:
dylan: noted. we'll file a short incident report and include the PD rule diff in the change.
pm-ryan: thanks everyone. main takeaways: misbound PD rule triggered wrong rota, oncall handled gracefully, small user impact. schedule a short postmortem and PD rule hardening.
alex.k: closing thread, will post link to the postmortem when created.
